Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this. We're updating our vendor coverage and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report and any associated bridge letter that covers the audit period overlapping with our procurement window. Specifically:

- We need a copy of the SOC 2 Type II report that covers controls for the period that includes 2025-06-01 through 2025-11-30 (we understand vendor audit periods can differ; please confirm exact start/end dates).
- If the report's audit period doesn't exactly match the dates above, please provide a bridge letter or accountant statement that describes coverage and any gaps.
- We also need a minimal evidence manifest (one-page checklist) showing where to find retained logs, retention policy doc, and encryption key management evidence.

Operational asks: can you share via SFTP or a Google Drive link? Also please include any redaction guidance (PII/tenant data) and a short template we can include in our security intake (example: what to say to procurement when the audit window is adjacent rather than overlapping).

Target timeline: would appreciate receipt by close of business 2026-06-05 so we can get internal review scheduled.

Thanks — happy to set a 15-min call if helpful.

Elena Ruiz

security@orbitapps.com

2) Audience: will the report be shared only with your internal procurement/compliance team, or do you need a version for public filing as well?

Thanks, Jonas — good questions.

- Scope: production-facing hosted API is sufficient for this phase. We may request dedicated/private evidence later if the contract proceeds.
- Audience: internal security + procurement only (no public filing).
- DocuSign: not required at this stage; a certified PDF + bridge letter is fine.

Also: we typically accept a short manifest listing where to find: retention policy doc, auth logs for a sample week, KMS snapshots showing rotation policy, and system architecture diagram. If you can point to specific artifact names/paths in the checklist, that speeds our review.

We'll plan to review anything you send by 2026-06-08. If you can include a one-line reply template for procurement (we'll use it in our vendor note), that would be great.

Elena
